description: Mainnet fee-bump transaction (CAP-0015) whose inner transaction declares a fee of 0, wrapping a USDC payment whose operation source differs from the inner transaction source. The fee source pays the whole fee (200 stroops charged of a 2,000,000 bid). The ledger records the outer hash in tx_processing and the inner hash inside the fee-bump result.

core_version_and_commit.basis: UNVERIFIED: a mainnet ledger at protocol 29 from the public data lake; the data-lake emitter does not publish its core build

generator_version: none (historical capture from the public Galexie data lake)

xdr_json.why: CAP-0015: the inner fee may be below the minimum; Horizon inner_transaction.max_fee is 0
the inner hash as Horizon reports it (inner_transaction.hash)

expected_state_changes_or_participants.indexer_must: use the outer hash as the transaction ID and the inner source for the transaction's source; charge the fee to the fee source, not the inner source; keep the operation source when it differs from the transaction source
expected_state_changes_or_participants.note: the payment changes only the two USDC trustlines; no account entry changes in the operation meta

validation_evidence.check: rs-stellar-xdr strict decode and byte-exact re-encode
ledger header hash recomputed from header bytes and matched to the recorded ledger hash
validation_evidence.method: ledgerwitness verify; ledger hash independently read from Horizon mainnet /ledgers/{seq}

validation_evidence.check: scp_value.tx_set_hash and tx_set_result_hash recomputed from the artifact
header signed by a pinned mainnet validator
every envelope hashes under the declared passphrase to a processed result

validation_evidence.method: not applicable to network captures: core goldens are produced by core's own test suite under its test passphrase; see docs/spec/normalization.md

validation_evidence.check: outer and inner hashes, success, fee charged, fee account, inner source, operation source and payment as Horizon reports them; ledger transaction count
validation_evidence.method: GET horizon mainnet /transactions/{hash}, /transactions/{hash}/operations and /ledgers/65566583 (successful plus failed transaction counts)

validation_evidence.check: no second copy of the ledger
validation_evidence.method: SDF runs no public mainnet RPC; the data-lake copy is the only artifact, so the meta is trusted to that emitter

license_or_provenance_notes: Public mainnet ledger data from the public Galexie data lake (AWS Open Data, aws-public-blockchain). The focus transaction was submitted by a third party.
